scene_analysis.scene_overview: A wide city street with buildings on both sides, lined with trees and cars parked along the curb. The sun shines down on the street, casting shadows across the asphalt. A person walks down the sidewalk on the right side of the street, while others stand near the parked cars. The sky is blue with wispy white clouds.
scene_analysis.buildings: The buildings on the left are tall and feature a mix of windows and balconies, while those on the right have a more uniform facade with fewer windows. The buildings appear to be made of stone or concrete.
scene_analysis.materials: The street is paved with asphalt and has yellow lines painted on it, indicating parking spaces. The sidewalk is made of concrete and has a few cracks.
scene_analysis.street_furniture: There are several benches and trash cans scattered along the sidewalk, as well as a few bicycles parked against the curb.
scene_analysis.vegetation: The trees lining the street are mostly bare, with only a few leaves still clinging to their branches. There are also some small bushes and shrubs planted along the sidewalk.
scene_analysis.signage: There are several signs posted along the street, including a large sign reading 'One Way' and a smaller sign indicating a pedestrian crossing.
